customers.evidence: empathize the needs of our clients and customers in ways that other banks simply cannot

dei.evidence: Our diverse leadership team is committed to stewarding a firm known for excellence.

community.evidence: We believe in playing a leading role in solving increasingly interconnected societal challenges.

integrity.evidence: We set goals and we hold ourselves accountable to reaching them.

innovation.evidence: We are transforming Citi into a modern, simpler, more efficient bank.

result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational, largely factual tone built on scale statistics. Speaks mainly to clients and customers, with first-person plural 'we'. ESG and societal commitments are framed as beliefs and self-accountability rather than hard targets. Workforce, safety and shareholder returns are largely absent.
